Title

create_deploy_ci_stage.Rd

Title

Usage

create_deploy_ci_stage(
  image,
  deploy_function,
  stage_name = deploy_function,
  ...
)

Arguments

image

image#'

deploy_function

deploy_function

stage_name

stage_name

...

dots not used

Examples

create_deploy_ci_stage(
  image = "rocker/verse",
  deploy_function = "deploy_connect_shiny"
)
